[[File:Greg Heisler DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|Greg Heisler at [[DecipherCon 1999]]. Photo: Decipher.<ref name="sat54">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat54.html DecipherCon 1999 photo: Saturday, sat54], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000602105923/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat54.html Internet Archive]</ref>]]
'''Greg Heisler''' of St. Louis won the [[Young Jedi]] World Championship at [[DecipherCon 1999]], defeating [[Matthew Reed|Matt Reed]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="lal-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 3 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120012500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sat54" /><ref name="insider48" /> In Star Wars CCG he finished 4th of 32 at the [[February 1997 St. Louis tournament]]<ref name="nf-stl97">[http://rothko.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/stlouistournament.html And the Last shall be the First: Tourney Report from St. Louis], Decipher NewsFlash (Robert Hallaman Jr., 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327231956/http://rothko.decipher.com:80/newsandhighlights/stlouistournament.html Internet Archive]</ref> and 8th of 90 at the [[2000 Death Star II Pre-Release (Normal)]].<ref name="f-t8037-311990">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=311990#p311990 SWCCG other "Big Events"], Players Committee forum (Bane Slader, 2 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027125252/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t8037-start40.html Internet Archive]</ref> Under the DeckTech handle '''rabidjedi''' he posted a [[Light]] [[Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|Agents In The Court]] list in October 2000.<ref name="dt-11098">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11098 The Light Side Deck of Doom v2 0], DeckTech (Greg "rabidjedi" Heisler, 13 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11098/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11098/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018110157/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11098/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
